scope: Shared original Game keyboard mapping and playable canonical vehicles in the installed Office. Full Game/Engine/Office integration remains active.

implementation.sampler: GameInput and the Office library share GameControlSampler. Original foot/car/aircraft, held intent, gear edges, modifiers, pulses, mouse, touch and gamepad math are preserved. Office currently supplies keyboard intent; its native flight and combat/gamepad UI remain unverified.
implementation.authority: Office supplies only validated keyboard codes and finite view angles. Seat assignment, boarding, ignition, door rights, lift selection, driver/passenger control and vehicle physics remain in the existing GameAuthority.
implementation.cadence: The Office controller samples held intent at its existing nominal 60 Hz timer and uses GameNetwork.send. No Office motor, vehicle or NPC simulation is added.
implementation.lifecycle: Blur, hidden page, pointer cancellation, dialogs, control/body/revision changes and leaving clear intent. Repeated enter preserves the existing controller and reliable command generation.
implementation.camera: Camera rays ignore original model meshes owned by the presented subject vehicle during boarding/seating. Other vehicles and architecture remain obstacles. Original dynamicScene prioritizes the subject hull through the same original self seat/boarding fields; the render-only observer is still invisible.
implementation.ui: Compact play shows context help. Driver/passenger hints read current authority input context, while geometry and models keep the presented frame.

oracle.scope: Frozen pre-refactor GameInput.sample versus the shared sampler: foot, car and aircraft, gear edges, E/G/F, pedals, modifiers, touch, mouse, gamepad, pulses and resets; no authority pose is changed.

assets.limits: Expanded triangle oracle uses additional Node assertions; this is not whole-world lighting acceptance.

checks: Installed Office UI TypeScript and Vite production build
verification.warning: Existing Office production chunk exceeds 1500 kB.

runtime.services: The canonical Game server and native Office/backend/microphone services were not restarted in this phase.

attempts.label: office-controls-first
attempts.result: Rejected: QA process had not registered the original wagon catalog. Fixed by registerFleet only; no vehicle spawn.

attempts.label: office-controls-registered
attempts.result: Rejected: the 700 ms drive check did not show motion, and the real own-car camera collision was visible. Later QA waits for actual sent sequence, authority ACK and engine idle; the specific cause of the earlier drive failure is not proven.

attempts.label: office-controls-ack
attempts.result: Partial only: driver, ignition, 1.835 m drive and corrected camera passed. The QA walking route after exit ran into the car; the controller later became observer. Closure cause remains undetermined. Passenger QA now repeats the original Game immediate-G-after-exit flow.

attempts.label: office-controls-passenger
attempts.result: Passed: driver, 1.317 m drive, passenger displacement zero, exits and cleanup.

attempts.label: office-controls-release
attempts.result: Passed: Game-to-Office identity, full vehicle flow and additional 65 s idle. Image review showed stale role help; the final phase uses current authority context and explicitly checks visible role hints.

limits: This step does not finish full static-world/material/sky/light fidelity or overall performance.
No fresh averaged FPS sample in this phase; the previous 35.66 FPS / 704x396 sample is historical.

Native keyboard walking, one original wagon, ignition, braking, driver/passenger/exit, role hints, cross-entry identity and additional 65-second idle are accepted; aircraft, police beacons, live Office door control, mouse combat/gamepad and other remaining interactive/audio flows are not broadly accepted by this run.
A previous long route/controller closure is not explained by the successful idle checks; do not claim its cause was fixed.
Initial Office entry metadata readiness can still precede a complete rendered first city frame.

All 19 final PNGs were inspected. transport-exited.png is a transient green close-up although the sampled camera reports 8 m and no hit. The later settled idle frame is correct. The cause and continuous exit-frame visual fidelity are still unproven.

The final capture now records HTTP failure paths without query strings: Office favicon.ico returned 404; an api/office/world request returned 403 around controller cleanup. No all-network-errors-free claim. Existing autoplay/powerPreference/atomFamily messages remain.
No physical microphone enable or native microphone/backend restart was performed.
All existing unrelated dirty work was preserved; no PR or commit was created.
